title: Horror Hallway Android
description: A pale humanoid android with visible mechanical joints and red blood splatters stumbles through a derelict hallway, arms flailing in distress. The walls are covered with ornate framed paintings of screaming and grotesque figures, all heavily smeared and dripping with blood under harsh fluorescent lighting.
prompt: A pale humanoid robot with exposed joints and blood splatters stumbles frantically down a narrow derelict hallway, arms raised in panic, its face showing distress.
